mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_submission WHERE student_no = #{studentNo} ORDER BY submit_time DESC, submission_id DESC
SELECT * FROM task_submission WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} ORDER BY submit_time DESC, submission_id DESC
SELECT s.* FROM task_submission s INNER JOIN learning_task t ON t.task_no = s.task_no WHERE t.course_code = #{courseCode} ORDER BY s.submit_time DESC, s.submission_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_submissions, COUNT(DISTINCT student_no) AS submitted_students, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'graded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS graded_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_overdue = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_count, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'graded' AND score IS NOT NULL THEN score END), 0) AS average_score FROM task_submission WHERE task_no = #{taskNo} AND (status IS NULL OR status != 'superseded')

SELECT t.task_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.task_name, ''), NULLIF(t.description, ''), '任务#' || t.task_no) AS task_name, t.task_type, COALESCE(a.assigned_count, 0) AS assigned_count, COUNT(s.submission_id) AS submitted_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'graded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS graded_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_overdue = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_count, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN s.status = 'graded' AND s.score IS NOT NULL THEN s.score END), 0) AS average_score FROM learning_task t LEFT JOIN task_submission s ON s.task_no = t.task_no AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status != 'superseded') LEFT JOIN ( SELECT task_no, COUNT(*) AS assigned_count FROM task_assignment WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY task_no ) a ON a.task_no = t.task_no WHERE t.course_code = #{courseCode} GROUP BY t.task_no, t.task_name, t.description, t.task_type, a.assigned_count ORDER BY t.task_no DESC

SELECT ranked.submission_id, ranked.task_no, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.task_name, ''), NULLIF(t.description, ''), '任务#' || t.task_no) AS task_name, t.task_type, ranked.student_no, COALESCE(st.name, '') AS student_name, ranked.content, ranked.file_path, ranked.submit_time, ranked.score, ranked.status, ranked.feedback, ranked.attempt_number FROM ( SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY s.student_no ORDER BY COALESCE(s.attempt_number, 0) DESC, s.submit_time DESC, s.submission_id DESC ) AS rn FROM task_submission s WHERE s.task_no = #{taskNo} AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status != 'superseded') ) ranked LEFT JOIN learning_task t ON t.task_no = ranked.task_no LEFT JOIN student st ON st.student_no = ranked.student_no WHERE ranked.rn = 1 ORDER BY ranked.submit_time DESC, ranked.submission_id DESC
